# Dataset validation

## Flow

Asserts that a dataset is uploaded and selected.

1. click [validate dataset button](#validate-dataset-button)
    - show [new validation modal](#new-validation-modal)
2. select profile
4. click "start validation":
    - auto-select schema based on dataset odm-version
    - show [validation modal](#validation-modal) and run validation
    - append validation result
    - show validation summary

## Components

### Validate dataset button

This button is found in the sidebar when a dataset is selected. It should show
the [new validation modal](#new-validation-modal) when clicked.

### New validation modal

This modal sets up a new validation to be run.

- validation profile dropdown:
    - decides which profile to use for the validation
    - default is "ODM profile"
- validation profile rule list:
    - list all active rules in selected profile
- customize validation button:
    - show [edit validation profile modal](validation-profiles.md#edit-validation-profile-modal)
- start validation button:
    - close this modal
    - show [validation modal](#validation-modal)
- cancel button:
    - close this modal

### Validation modal

This modal shows the validation progress. An Interval component is used to
periodically run a callback which updates the progress bar value. When the
validation completes, it will transition to the [validation summary screen](#validation-summary-screen).

- dataset name text
- validation progress-bar:
    - progress-update interval
- cancel button:
    - ask for confirmation:
        - cancel validation
        - close this modal

### Validation summary screen

This screen shows the summary of the selected validation. It can be reached by
clicking on a previous validation link in the sidebar. The user will also be
transitioned to this screen after completing a validation.

- dataset name text
- validation summary text
- view validation report button:
    - show [validation report modal](#validation-report-modal)

### Validation report modal

This modal shows the validation report and provides options for download.

- dataset name text
- validation number (for the current dataset)
- validation report text
- download section:
    - format dropdown (csv, yaml, json)
    - error level dropdown (error, warning)
    - download button:
        - download report as specified above
- close button:
    - close modal

## Implementation

### State

global variables [don't really work with Dash](https://dash.plotly.com/sharing-data-between-callbacks#why-global-variables-will-break-your-app),
but it may work for validation progress if combined with a session id. The
session id can be embedded into the page as a component, and passed into the
validation function as an argument. This ensures that different users won't
overwrite each others progress value.

```python
validation_progress: Dict[SessionId, float]
```

### Stores

All flags have type `bool`, and are using ephemeral memory storage.

#### Validation

- new-validation-modal (flag)
- validation-modal (flag)
- validation-report-modal (flag)
- validation-reports:
    - type: `Dict[DatasetId, List[CompressedText]]`
    - storage: local

    Validation reports can be big (> 1 MB) which makes it difficult to store
    multiple of them in local storage (which has a limit of 10 MB), however,
    they can be compressed (with the zlib package), which should make it
    feasable since they contain a lot of duplicate data.

- validation-start-signal (flag):

    Signals the validation to start. The actual validation must be run in a
    separate callback because it's blocking. Dash is multi-threaded, so other
    callbacks can continue as normal while it's running.

### Callbacks

new-validation-modal:
- on_new_validation_modal(flag):
    - set new-validation-modal.is_open = flag
- on_profile_selected(profile):
    - set rule list to profile.rules.names
- on_customize_validation_btn:
    - set [edit-profile-modal](validation-profiles.md#stores)
- on_start_validation_btn:
    - reset new-validation-modal
    - set validation-modal
    - set validation-modal.dataset-name
    - set validation-modal.progress-bar
- on_cancel_new_validation_btn:
    - reset new-validation-modal

validation-modal:
- on_validation_modal(flag):
    - set validation-modal.is_open = flag
    - set validation-start-signal
- on_validation_start(dataset):
    - access dataset (refer to [dataset upload](dataset-upload.md) for details)
    - call [validate](#validate-function) (blocking)
    - append result to validation-reports[dataset.id]
- on_validation_interval:
    - set progress-bar.value = validation_progress

### Functions

#### Validate function

```python
from odm_validation.validation import validate_data_ext

def validate(..., on_progress, session_id) -> report:
    global validation_progress
    validation_progress[session_id] = 0

    def on_progress(..., current, total):
        validation_progress[session_id] = current / total * 100

    return validate_data_ext(..., on_progress)
```
